duplicate-logic-rule.desc: Verifies that no run of statements is repeated anywhere in the codebase. Every duplicated run is reported as a group: the set of locations that share it.
duplicate-logic-rule.equivalence: Two runs are duplicates when one can be turned into the other by renaming identifiers (i.e. a "p-match", or Type-2 clone).

config.item: min_stmts - how short a repeated run may be before it is reported; runs of fewer statements than this are ignored (default 2).
ignore - list of group ids to skip (copy them from the violation output)
